concerns.text: FR-014 requires the system to produce a cleaned dataset containing at least 3 500 alloy records for each modelling target after all cleaning steps, but no task explicitly asserts this requirement.

FR-011 mandates that the entire end‑to‑end pipeline complete within 6 hours on a free‑tier CI runner; the current tasks (including T010) do not include a runtime benchmark or pass/fail check for this overall wall‑clock limit.
